walkthrough: Goal: draw clean shapes and symmetric patterns by hand, as Procreate's QuickShape and Drawing Guide > Symmetry do: a stroke held still at its end becomes the shape it resembles, and with the guide on every stroke is drawn mirrored; each stroke is one undo step and reopening keeps what was drawn.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library. With the pen, draw an oval round the middle of the canvas, come back near where it began and keep the pen still on the glass.

QuickShape: after half a second of holding still, the stroke snaps into an exact ellipse (a circle when drawn nearly round), keeping the pressure the hand gave it along its length. Still pressing, moving the pen turns and sizes the shape about its middle (a line or an open shape about its start). Lift: the ellipse stays; a pill in the top band's middle says Edit shape.

Edit shape: tap it. Four handles appear at the ends of the ellipse's axes and the pill says Done. Drag the right handle outwards with the pen (or a finger): the ellipse widens, the other axis keeps its length. Tap Done (or draw, or do anything else): the handles and the pill go. One undo takes the ellipse away, drawn, snapped and edited alike; redo brings back the edited ellipse.

Line: draw a slightly wobbly straight stroke and hold at its end: it snaps to the straight line from where it began to where the pen rests. A rectangle, a triangle or a zigzag snap to their corners, an arc to its circle; a scribble, a spiral or a wave held still stay as drawn; holding shorter than half a second changes nothing.

Symmetry: open Actions; under Canvas, after the reference rows, turn on Drawing Guide (Vertical at first) and tap Radial; a hint says a finger moves the centre. Close Actions. Faint lines cross the canvas through its middle, four of them 45 degrees apart, with a faint handle at their centre. Draw a wave: it appears eight times at once, mirrored across the four lines, while it is drawn. Lift: the eight strokes are one undo step; the eraser and the smudge are mirrored alike; fills and selections are not.
Move the centre: drag the faint centre handle with a finger; the lines follow and the next stroke mirrors about the new centre. The pen never moves the centre, so a stroke begun at the centre draws.
Failure: nothing fails here; a stroke that resembles no shape stays as drawn.
Cancel: turn Drawing Guide off in Actions: strokes are drawn once again (the symmetry chosen stays for next time). Undo takes back the last stroke and all its copies.
Reopen: leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: every stroke, snapped shape and copy is as left; the Drawing Guide is off (it lives for the artwork's session only).
